proposed_core_edits.reason: The proof establishes compactness, boundary-nullness, a uniform surface modulus, and both directed grid approximations from the bounded coordinate-density envelope alone; the Lipschitz-density dependency is unused and must be removed.

proposed.justification: Continuous-time conclusions require more than solving unrelated finite grids; compactness and Hausdorff convergence transfer exact support certificates to the scientific time scale, and bounded finite-part coordinate densities alone supply every required modulus and null-boundary property.
proposed.gap: Generic optimal-transport consistency does not address strict within-arm event order, a nested survivor denominator, or uniform convergence of a two-index surface image; Lipschitz density regularity is not needed for this qualitative convergence result.
proposed.consumer: It justifies refining the clinical horizon grid without changing the estimand or losing sharpness under the bounded-density class.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The reciprocal dependency on the continuous-grid theorem is obsolete. Lipschitz regularity remains used only by the smooth witness and the open simultaneous-inference route.

prose_updates.tldr: Death truncates readmission, so the two-index TV-SACE and RM-SACE surfaces depend on an unidentified cross-world assignment of treated readmission times to control death times. After the proved full-horizon IPCW recovery lemma identifies the complete within-arm laws, and under the additional maintained order \(D(0)\le D(1)\), the note characterizes the complete sharp monotonicity-restricted surface by a necessary-and-sufficient marked-capacity lift, proves common fixed-cohort extremizers and exact RM integration, and gives a certified three-horizon law whose joint cross-cohort support is strictly narrower than its coordinate rectangle. Quadratic chain flows, qualitative continuous-grid convergence, and deterministic-grid finite-sample outer containment make the population characterization computable. A joint marked-product-limit/IPCW functional limit, root-\(n\) grid-bias control, and simultaneous multiplier bands remain open.

project_justification.fill: The note proves the monotonicity-restricted if-and-only-if marked-capacity image, a measurable four-event-time full-law lift, common fixed-cohort extremizers on \(S(t)\geq\eta\), exact RM integration, an atomic strict cross-cohort support certificate, quadratic computation with a dual infimum, qualitative continuous approximation under the bounded finite-part coordinate-density envelope alone, and deterministic-grid finite-sample outer containment with \(D=\tau\) retained in the last bin. The continuous approximation needs no Lipschitz-density restriction. The separated-bump extension and smooth nonidentification transfer hold on every explicit envelope regime \(M\geq M_\delta\), \(L_{\mathrm{Lip}}\geq L_\delta\); no claim is made for arbitrary smaller fixed envelopes or for enlarged-class capacity sharpness.
